notes_for_editor: Thin: three sources. The 2016 tnlandforms list gives the name, coordinates and elevation; an undated Forest Lookouts Georgia list gives the Georgia Forestry Commission credit; Mapcarta gives the alias and an OpenStreetMap tower tag. No build date, design, status, access or photo found. The Commons Georgia Forestry Commission tower category has no image of this tower, and the tower is not on the NHLR Georgia index or FFLOS in the cache. The list gives no elevation unit, so the story flags feet as an assumption (feet is only inferred from the list's other values, such as Brasstown Lookout Tower at 4735). The story is about 100 words, under the 120-word floor; kept short rather than padded. Editor may choose to hold it until a build or status source turns up.
